description: Unit tests for platform_canvas functionality in Skia, focusing on native drawing, clipping, layers, and translation on Windows.

classes.name: LayerSaver
classes.description: Helper class to save and restore canvas layers with specified bounds.

methods.name: MakeOpaque
methods.description: Sets a rectangle area on the canvas to opaque black using DstATop blend mode.

methods.name: IsOfColor
methods.description: Checks if a pixel at (x, y) in a bitmap matches a specified color, ignoring alpha masking.

methods.name: VerifyRect
methods.description: Verifies that a specified rectangle in the canvas is filled with rect_color and outside with canvas_color.

methods.name: VerifyRoundedRect
methods.description: Verifies that a rounded rectangle in the canvas has correct corner and middle pixel colors.

methods.name: VerifyBlackRect
methods.description: Checks if a rectangle in the canvas is filled with black on a white background.

methods.name: VerifyCanvasColor
methods.description: Checks if the entire canvas is filled with a single color.

methods.name: DrawNativeRect
methods.description: Draws a rectangle using native Windows drawing context.

methods.name: AddClip
methods.description: Adds a rectangular clip to the canvas.
